title: Summary: Remotes and Sharing
objective: Share a repository through a bare copy, have a clone push a change, pull it back, and print the remote's name and the history.
hint: Follow the last step: commit the README, make shared.git, add origin, push -u, clone, change and push from the clone, then Set-Location back and git pull -q --ff-only origin main. Then Write-Output Remote: with $(git remote), and the log.
